notes.title: Game Update. New CGs with Leeka! Get to know Leeka of Zeliria, open the news!
notes.content:
Dear friends! We've updated the game by adding CG with Leeka!
Also, we would like to remind you that this game is a crossover. You can find out the true story of Leeka the catgirl, in the Zeliria Sanctuary project.
